method: Visual self-assessment against the sole uploaded image, supplemented by independent agent review. Scores are subjective and are not a certification of AAA production quality.
scope: Recorded assessments whose numeric results remain available. No missing historical scores have been invented.

assessments.notes: Reference skin and revised face optics helped; hair coverage, roots, long clumps, and tailoring still limited realism.
Fuller card groom, finer fringe, cheek strap removed, brighter cotton and shoulder counterpose. Crown seams and regular long hair bundles remain visible.
Neck colors from the same uploaded reference improve continuity with the face. Keep facial proportions stable while correcting hair. Upper neck rim was subsequently tucked inside jaw geometry.

Twelve thousand subpixel tubes produce sparse, noisy coverage, bald crown gaps and two uniform long bundles. Three million triangles did not improve visual quality. Default remains the accepted card groom.
Continuous coverage solves sparse tubes, but exposes a scalp patch, narrow paired long bundles and abrupt crown/back boundaries.
Cleaner collar/placket, rounder closed ear shell, corrected neck rim, balanced lights and restrained corneal reflection. Hair still limits overall realism.
Removed photographic hair contamination from temple colors, preserving the source eye and mouth anchors. Ear tessellation reduced while preserving silhouette; anatomy budget passes.
New crown flow and layered locks still have a nape transition kink and early shoulder flare. Found shared palette mutation turning fine fringe black; correction requested.
Denser hair body and depth ordering remove white shirt gaps. Shortened nape core removes central back hem. Broad opaque locks and shoulder cutout still limit realism; independent review keeps 67.

assessments.decision: not adopted; crown frame correction pending
assessments.notes: Corrected palette mutation and continuous nape improve experimental groom. Crown comb ridges, raised roots, broad flat temple flaps and uniformly fanned tips remain. Skin illumination compensation at 0.35 adopted after independent comparison, without a score increase.

assessments.decision: accepted restrained color and material calibration on existing groom
assessments.notes: Controlled comparison shows large inter-lock color differences cause painted stripes. Compressed those differences and selected moderate anisotropy. Strong white reflections expose broad card geometry and were not adopted on the old groom.

assessments.decision: accepted continuous collar support and shared eye tangent correction
assessments.notes: Removed the hard collar support discontinuity and aligned upper facing. Eye surfaces share a small depth correction reducing outward center tilt, without moving the aperture corners. Front and profile renders remain coherent; anatomy checks pass.

Correct ellipsoid frames, softer ash chestnut surface, varied waves and improved shoulder contact now outweigh the previous groom. Remaining defects include large lower gaps, opaque temple flaps, gray fringe and crown patch boundaries. Independent overall score 70.

assessments.decision: retained accepted corneal material after diagnostic comparison
assessments.notes: Compared baseline, no environment reflection, hidden cornea and reduced refraction in front and oblique views. Material-only changes offer little convincing improvement; physical corneal baseline retained. No score increase.

104 inner curved locks substantially close large lower gaps; darker fringe better matches the source. Regular pointed back ends, hard crown patches and bright temple chips remain. Native WebGPU, finite geometry and idle demand rendering verified.

assessments.decision: accepted targeted skin atlas cleanup; further jaw correction pending
assessments.notes: Feathered source jaw guard removes the black jaw chip. Averaged clean source patches reduce lateral bands, and a rear atlas improves albedo continuity. A diagonal brown lower-jaw mark remains and is being corrected. No feature coordinates changed.

assessments.decision: retained baseline ear material after comparison
assessments.notes: Stronger procedural concha and canal color variations produce little visible depth improvement. They were not adopted. Geometry occlusion and ear surface relief require investigation.
Staggered rear ends improve but the common root alpha cutoff exposes a horizontal band around the crown. Ear wisps extend too far. Restored the accepted35 groom for the isolated cloth comparison.

assessments.decision: accepted bounded cloth relief and beveled buttons
assessments.notes: Button pulls and lower placket crease read in close view, without changing collar or neck coordinates or adding draw calls. Five-view render shows no new hair/cloth intersections.

assessments.decision: accepted narrower jaw guard; local tone corrections pending
assessments.notes: The long brown jaw edge is reduced while protected feature samples remain stable. A smaller cheek triangle and central chin patch persist in unlit atlas diagnosis and are being traced to exact source samples.

The horizontal ring is removed and crown ridges reduced. Independent overall72. Large lock roots still produce localized crown patches and folded temple chips; individual raycast triangles identify the affected front guides. Graphic fringe and pointed back ends remain.

assessments.decision: retained softer portrait lighting after cloth comparison
assessments.notes: Compared baseline cotton, removal of previous cloth color boost, and stronger lateral key light. Stronger light shows cloth relief but changes neck/face tone; no global lighting or cloth color change adopted.

assessments.decision: accepted ear anatomy and localized skin tone repairs
assessments.notes: Integrated source candidates41 and43. Closed ear shell retains outline and triangle budget; right head seat clears buried cartilage. Geometry tests pass and five-view inspection shows no regression. Confirmed cheek/chin source-shadow patches are locally neutralized while protected features and fine source detail remain.

assessments.decision: 6 percent lower-face candidate selected; acceptance waits for neck repair
assessments.notes: Compared0,4,6,8 percent shortening below fixed eye level with attached UV colors. Independent reviewer prefers6 percent. Small neck edge becomes exposed, so this runtime-only deformation is not yet accepted as default. Full portrait and profile recheck pending.

assessments.decision: antialiasing experiment shows benefit; integration pending
assessments.notes: Twice internal resolution improves thin-strand edge quality at the same displayed size. A12-sample diagnostic measured queue medians9.5ms at900x1200 and17.7ms at1800x2400; these are small-sample measurements, not an FPS guarantee. Requested output dimensions must remain unchanged if adopted.
